name: healthlog-baseline-anchor
description: Anchor and verify wearable baselines (EEG/EMG/HRV) on Solana. Only a commitment hash + shape metadata goes on-chain; raw baseline parameters stay encrypted off-chain. RPC Fast is the mainnet verification rail.
note: Depends on @solana/web3.js, bs58 (resolved from ~/node_modules via parent-dir lookup). RPC/keypair read from ~/.axiom_resolve/.
